payload.description: The council's allowances schedule has four money columns — basic allowance, special responsibility, expenses and total — but prints a figure in only three of them for almost everyone. Read as text, there is no way to tell whether the middle figure is a special responsibility allowance or expenses. This page therefore shows the basic allowance and the total, which are unambiguous, and says nothing about special responsibility for anyone.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
